loops.name: kinz-dispatch
loops.title: KINZ · Night dispatcher
loops.purpose: The one claude.ai routine for all cloud jobs. Fires at 01:45 and 06:45, while Nassim sleeps, so loop work never uses up the KINZ account's daytime usage limit. Runs whichever jobs are due (scripts/due_jobs.py).

loops.name: kinz-upkeep
loops.title: KINZ · Upkeep — CI, dependencies, merges
loops.purpose: Merge green dependency updates and green agent PRs, fix red CI, resolve conflicts, across all repos.
loops.details:
Daily sweep of every Kinz-org repo in the registry (not the vault, not loop-engine-state).
• Merges green Dependabot updates; asks Dependabot to rebase conflicted ones, closes them after two tries.
• Takes over agent PRs (claude/loop-…): merges them when CI is green, resolves conflicts, fixes red CI (two attempts, then closes PRs older than 7 days).
• Fixes a red default branch when the cause is clear; adds a pull-request CI workflow to a repo that has none.
• Accounting repo: never merges a change to how a reported figure is derived — labels it 'hold' for you.
Merge rules: CI ran and passed, no workflow file edited, no test weakened.
Output: merged PRs, a run record in runs/, one status line on your phone.

loops.name: kinz-market-watch
loops.title: KINZ · Market watch — competitor data check
loops.purpose: Read-only check of the weekly KINZ scrape data; runs the night after Monday's scrape. Writes findings only.
loops.details:
Read-only check of the weekly competitor scrape, the night after Monday's GitHub Actions run.
• Downloads competitors.db from the 'weekly-scrape-data' release of kinz-competitor-intelligence.
• Counts competitors, products and price history; finds competitors the scrape missed, suspicious prices (zeros, identical clusters), the 100-product pagination bug, and price moves over 30%.
• Never prints contact names, phones or emails; deletes the database at the end.
Changes nothing in the repo. Output: a new dated section in findings/kci-data-quality.md.

loops.name: kinz-polish
loops.title: KINZ · Polish — improvements on two repos
loops.purpose: Top improvement-list item on 2 repos by rotation; refill a repo's list when it runs low. Merges when green.
loops.details:
Monday, Wednesday and Friday: real improvements on the next two repos of the rotation.
• Reads each repo's docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md and refills it to 3–5 items found in the code when it runs low.
• Fixes the top open item on its own branch, with a regression test for every bug, and ticks it off in the same PR.
• Merges when CI is green; money, tax and reported-figure logic goes to an Opus subagent with tests that pin the numbers.
Output: up to two merged PRs, rotation cursor moved, notes for future runs in registry.json.

loops.name: kinz-ledger
loops.title: KINZ · Ledger — accounting repo fixes
loops.purpose: Kinz accounting repo improvement pass: 1-3 well-tested fixes, merged when green. Figure-changing PRs wait for Nassim.
loops.details:
Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday: 1 to 3 tested fixes in kinz-accounting-analysis.
• Runs pytest, ruff and the read-only verifier; rebuilds reports offline from the committed extract (never calls Odoo).
• Looks for wrong maths, dead code paths, reports that contradict their data, stale docs, missing tests.
• Tax and money reasoning goes to an Opus subagent. A change to a reported figure is left open with the 'hold' label and a NEEDS YOU alert.
Output: merged test/doc/fix PRs, held figure changes for you.

loops.name: kinz-lab
loops.title: KINZ · Lab — weekly creative experiment
loops.purpose: One new idea in one repo; a fresh Opus agent checks it against a goal written first. Merges if verified and green.
loops.details:
Saturday: one new idea in one rotation repo, judged by an independent agent.
• Picks a repo (not last week's), chooses an idea that fits one PR, and writes 3–6 success checks in experiments/ before writing code.
• Builds it with tests, then a fresh Opus judge runs every check and answers VERIFIED or NOT VERIFIED.
• Merged only if VERIFIED and CI is green; one retry with a new judge, otherwise closed with the verdict.
Output: the experiment file with its verdict, and the PR.

loops.name: kinz-heartbeat
loops.title: KINZ · Heartbeat — one small fix if the day is empty
loops.purpose: Only if nothing landed today: one small, real fix, merged when green. Runs after the night jobs.
loops.details:
Every morning at 06:45, after the night jobs.
• If anything already landed today on a Kinz-org repo, it stops (status: skipped).
• Otherwise makes one small, real fix in the least recently updated rotation repo: an open improvement item, a wrong doc line, a missing test.
• No whitespace churn, no renames for their own sake. Merged when CI is green.
Output: at most one merged PR, so the contribution graph shows real work every day.

loops.name: kinz-digest
loops.title: KINZ · Monday digest — the week in one page
loops.purpose: Weekly report on Monday morning: what merged, what failed, what never ran, what's next.
loops.details:
Monday 06:45: the weekly report you read on your phone.
• Shipped: merged PRs per repo, with links.
• Broken or stuck: red CI, PRs left open, failures.
• Jobs that did not run: compares each job's schedule with its run records; 'missing' means it never fired.
• The Lab verdict, next week's rotation, and repos not attached to the routine (NEEDS YOU).
Changes no work repo. Output: reports/weekly-<year>-W<week>.md.

loops.name: kinz-portfolio
loops.title: KINZ · Portfolio review — three public repos
loops.purpose: Weekly portfolio review of three public Kinz-org repos, with small checkable fixes merged and the rest reported.
loops.details:
Sunday 01:45: the github-portfolio-builder method, applied to the three public repos reviewed longest ago.
• Reads each README and checks its claims against the code: links, badges, quick-start commands, license.
• Labels every finding verified, reported or unresolved; at most five per repo.
• Fixes and merges only small checkable things (wrong links, wrong badges, commands that don't match the code, README lines the code contradicts).
• Licenses, visibility, descriptions, claims about results and workflows are left to you, listed under 'Needs the owner'.
Output: reports/portfolio-<year>-W<week>.md and the merged PRs.

loops.name: kinz-vault
loops.title: KINZ · Vault gardener — Obsidian weekly pass
loops.purpose: Weekly upkeep of the Obsidian vault (Kinz-org/kinz-obsidian-vault) and a journal of what the loops did. Opens a PR; never merges.
loops.details:
Sunday 06:45, after the portfolio review: a gardening pass on the Obsidian vault, in French, in the vault's own style.
• Adds a missing 'type' to notes, links orphan notes from their hub, refreshes the Atlas 'Pistes à écrire' table, rebuilds the 3D planets view.
• Writes 'Journal des boucles — <year>-W<week>': every job of the week, its runs, merged PRs and open NEEDS YOU items.
• Never moves, renames or deletes a note; never touches .obsidian/ or Templates/; grey links stay — they are leads.
• Opens one PR and does NOT merge it: you review it in Obsidian, then merge.
Output: a vault PR and a NEEDS YOU alert with its link.

loops.name: kinz-genesis
loops.title: KINZ · Genesis — new private repo (laptop)
loops.purpose: Every 28 days, create one new private repo coherent with the portfolio. Stays on the laptop: cloud sessions cannot create repos.

calendar.note: Timer fires weekly; the prompt's 28-day gate decides. The calendar shows only the days it acts.

loops.details:
Every 28 days: one new private repo that fits the portfolio, created from the laptop because cloud sessions cannot create repos.
Disabled for Kinz-org until a second systemd timer, signed in to gh as kinzorg-afk, is set up on the laptop.

loops.name: kinz-zai
loops.title: KINZ · Z.ai session (paused)
loops.purpose: Z.ai work session on repos where registry worked_by == 'zai'. Paused until Z.ai has its own GitHub account.
